title: The Last Crown Again
author: Lior Nakamura
blurb: Edmund Winterbourne, a thief who steals memories, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
